drafts.title: Archived Report: Cerebras and Mistral Claim 1,100 Tokens/s Inference Speed on Mistral Large 2 Using Wafer Scale Engine 3
drafts.body: An archived third-party report from early 2025 details a collaboration between Cerebras and Mistral integrating Cerebras Inference into Mistral's Le Chat platform, achieving a reported AI inference speed breakthrough. Specifically, the system is claimed to generate text at 1,100 tokens per second using the 123 billion parameter Mistral Large 2 model. This speed reportedly represents a roughly 10x improvement over contemporaneous AI assistants like ChatGPT 4o (115 tokens/s) and Claude Sonnet 3.5 (71 tokens/s). The performance gain is attributed to Cerebras's Wafer Scale Engine 3 technology, which employs an SRAM-based inference architecture, combined with speculative decoding methods developed jointly with Mistral researchers. The new feature, called "Flash Answers," currently focuses on text-based queries and is visually indicated by a lightning bolt icon in the chat interface. It is important to note that these claims come from a third-party archive citing vendor statements, without independent verification, and the speed comparisons may not reflect identical test conditions or current rankings. Nonetheless, this report highlights the potential of hardware-software co-design in pushing the boundaries of LLM inference speed.
